description: Extend OAuth Behaviour with a pure validated runtime identity projection selected through Registry auth_profile. Resolver applies it only to selected grant; ProviderSpec translates identity to ReqLLM options. Codex exports chatgpt_account_id only; Standard never leaks arbitrary/Codex metadata. Tests first include person/org mismatch, ID-token-only identity, missing identity, invalid metadata and property allowlist checks. Extend existing behavior/registry/resolver APIs; no new Action/tool.
title: Behavior-owned OAuth runtime identity
